launch.ready: {n} of {of} ready to open Google's form

launch.nine.hint: then what stands behind it · ready rows fold to one line
launch.must.name: Name
launch.why.name: keyword name: a nom commercial at the top helps an appeal
launch.why.category: its trade, set up in its country with Google's category
launch.why.areas: up to 20 · they cover where the film is shot
launch.why.phone: routes to the closers · on no other GBP
launch.why.site: its page on our sites; its own domain: a shared site links profiles
launch.why.site.noAccess: linking a site page needs access to the sites
launch.why.hidden_address: customers don't visit → service area; the address is where the film is shot
launch.why.film: the verification film from the kit (verif_vid)
launch.why.gmail: the gmail that manages it: an owner holds 3, a manager 6
launch.why.profile: the gmail's antidetect browser: its fingerprint, its proxy in the GBP's country, its session
launch.profile.noGmail: pick its gmail first: the browser is the gmail's
gmbs.gmail.role.hint: optional · owners usually hold up to 3 GBPs, managers 6

trades.new.name: A trade's name: Plumbing
trades.study.why: With the scope on {category}, the Map panel shows this study. None: the category has no study.
trades.window.delete.body: Its categories go with it. No GBP holds it.
trades.window.delete.held: {n} GBPs hold it: give them another trade first
trades.window.pickCountry: Not set up anywhere yet: add a country.

scope.gmail.count: Its GBPs in the categories picked
trades.window.willAsk: It will ask: keywords in its language · Google's category · the study, if a grid covers it.
trades.google.where: copied in {lang}, as Google's form in {country} names it
trades.google.why: Off Google's own list. Every {category} draft's Launch tab shows them to type in.
trades.google.additional.order: Typed into Google's form in this order after the primary, and the order matters. Drag a chip, or move it with ‹ ›.
launch.category.then: then the additional ones, in this order:
trades.heldBy.what: one category, several gmails · click narrows the outline

account.imap.title: Email · IMAP
account.imap.how: Google account → Security → 2-step verification → App passwords. Checked by logging in before it is kept; never shown again.
account.imap.why: Inbox alerts and email automations will read it; nothing reads mail yet.
account.mapsKey.title: Google Maps key
account.mapsKey.order: Tried first for this gmail's GBPs, then for your other gmails', before the shared keys. Your own key costs no tokens.
account.mapsKey.cost: On the shared keys: {details} tokens a lookup, {search} a search.
account.mapsKey.unpriced: The shared keys are not priced yet: without a key of your own, Google lookups are refused.
browser.title: Antidetect environment
browser.device.drawn: A real Android phone; its model is drawn from Multilogin's Google and Samsung ones.
browser.how: socks5:// or http://, user:pass@host:port. Kept only once it exits in the country of this gmail's GBPs; the provider and device are set once.
browser.how.replace: The same profile, out through another proxy; checked before it is kept.
browser.remove.title: Remove the browser?
browser.remove.body: Its profile goes with it: the fingerprint, the cookies, the signed-in session. A new one starts from nothing.
browser.why: One fingerprint and one session for every GBP of this gmail, out through its proxy in their country.
browser.film.title: Film as camera
browser.film.none: An mp4 the next start plays as the back camera, its sound as the mic.
browser.film.set: Film set — the next start plays it as the back camera (5 s still, the film, last frame held 60 s).
browser.film.running: The browser runs: stop it first, the next launch plays the film.
browser.film.phone.none: An mp4 (up to 100 MiB) for Multilogin's Library: pick it in the phone's Camera panel in the Multilogin app.
browser.film.phone.set: Film in Multilogin's Library: pick it in the phone's Camera panel in the Multilogin app.
browser.film.phone.tooBig: The film is over 100 MiB: Multilogin's Library takes no more.
browser.session.none: No browser for this gmail yet
browser.session.none.body: Set up {gmail}'s antidetect environment on its Connections tab.
browser.session.taken: Another viewer of this gmail took over.
browser.session.lost: The connection to the browser was lost.
browser.session.elsewhere.gmail: It runs for the gmail alone, the position blocked.
browser.session.elsewhere.gbp: It runs for {name}, at its point.
browser.control.yes: You have control · keys and clicks go to the page
browser.control.no: Click the page to take control
prices.title: Places on the shared keys
prices.why: Tokens a Google Places request costs when a person has no Maps key of their own that answers. Cached answers and own keys cost nothing.
prices.unpriced: Not priced: requests on the shared keys are refused for everyone without a key of their own.
